title.zh: Strategy公布2026年第三季度财报：净利润195.3亿美元、持有848,517枚比特币，CFO将离任
title.en: Strategy Q3财报：营业利润约209亿美元创新高，比特币持仓848,517枚，CFO将离任

current_state.zh: Strategy posted record Q3 2026 results with $20.91B operating profit and $19.53B net income on $20.91B of digital asset gains, disclosed 848,517 BTC held (up 26% YTD) alongside $14.33B of YTD Bitcoin purchases and $2.04B of STRC repurchases, and announced that CFO Andrew Kang will step down on November 5 with operations EVP Reza Virasteh taking over on January 1, 2027.

updates.title_zh: Strategy 融资 54 亿美元，却几乎没买比特币
updates.title_en: Strategy raises $5.4B but barely buys bitcoin
updates.what_changed_zh:
Strategy 在 7 月至 9 月期间通过按市价（ATM）增发普通股融资 54 亿美元，但其中仅 5.88 亿美元用于购买比特币，相当于每融资 1 美元投入比特币不足 11 美分。公司同期还卖出 5,552 枚自有比特币，套现 3.486 亿美元，部分用于支付股息，部分用于回购其 STRC 优先股。

这一披露打破了此前的模式：2024 年几乎每一美元 ATM 融资都变成了比特币，即便在表现异常的 2025 年第三季度，每 1 美元中仍有逾 94 美分用于买入比特币。其意义在于，Strategy 是最大的企业级比特币储备公司，其融资中最终流向现货比特币购买的比例，是一条可直接观察的需求渠道。

Strategy 当季共买入 7,218 枚比特币，扣除卖出部分后，净持仓仅比季初增加 1,666 枚。在 10 月 26 日当周的披露中，新增 1.64 亿美元 MSTR 增发，每 1 美元中仅 40 美分用于购买比特币。
updates.what_changed_en:
Strategy raised $5.4 billion through at-the-market common stock sales between July and September but spent only $588 million of that on bitcoin — less than 11 cents of every dollar raised. The company also sold 5,552 of its own BTC for $348.6 million, partly to fund dividends and partly to repurchase its STRC preferred stock.

The disclosure breaks a pattern: in 2024 essentially every ATM dollar became bitcoin, and even in the anomalous third quarter of 2025 more than 94 cents of each dollar still bought BTC. The shift matters because Strategy is the largest corporate bitcoin treasury, so the share of its fundraising that reaches spot BTC purchases is a directly observable demand channel.

Strategy bought 7,218 BTC during the quarter and, after accounting for its sales, ended with just 1,666 more coins than it started with. In the reporting week of October 26, $164 million of fresh MSTR dilution saw only 40 cents of each dollar go toward BTC.

updates.background_zh: Strategy（原 MicroStrategy）已将自身重新定位为“比特币储备公司”，由于经营性现金流极少，其购币资金主要来自按市价增发股票（ATM）。其 STRC 是一只年股息率 12.00% 的永续优先股，股息率每月调整，以促使其价格在 100 美元面值附近交易；文章指出该股实际连续数月跌至 70 至 80 美元区间，令回购成本高昂。
updates.background_en: Strategy, formerly MicroStrategy, has repositioned itself as a "bitcoin treasury company" and funds most purchases by selling stock at the market (ATM), since operations generate minimal cash flow. Its STRC is a perpetual preferred stock paying 12.00% annual dividends, with a rate adjusted monthly to encourage trading near its $100 par value; the article notes it actually traded in the $70s and $80s for months, making repurchases costly.
updates.market_impact_zh: MSTR 股票被广泛用作间接持有比特币的替代标的，STRC 则是与同一张资产负债表挂钩的收益型工具。当每新增 1 美元融资中流入现货比特币购买的比例下降、同时又有比特币被卖出以支付优先股股息和回购时，这一储备渠道的边际需求贡献随之减弱，其供给方向则略微转为正向。
updates.market_impact_en: MSTR stock is a widely used proxy for indirect bitcoin exposure, and STRC is a yield instrument tied to the same balance sheet. If a smaller share of each new dollar raised converts into spot BTC purchases while some coins are sold to fund preferred dividends and buybacks, the marginal demand contribution from this treasury channel weakens and the supply side of that channel turns slightly positive.
